message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "AbstractUnArchiver", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In AbstractUnArchiver.extractFile, the archive entry name is passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) and the resulting File f is used directly in new FileOutputStream(f). There is no containment check, canonical-path validation, or allow-list verifying that f remains inside the destination directory before the FileOutputStream sink, so attacker-controlled entry names such as ../ paths can reach the sink."}]}
